value.rationale: A complete, natural two-dimensional spectral-versus-energy stability classification for the standard cubic RK endpoint: beyond the finite shear ceiling, no positive step is Euclidean contractive despite scalar eigenmode stability on an interval. The unique supercritical contractive island, singleton fold and square-root collapse differ qualitatively from the published fourth-order unbounded-shear behavior and motivate the precise invariant. No error-optimality, later-step or general-matrix consequence is claimed.
